work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act congratulates Ferdinand V on his marriage with Maria Anna of Sardinia. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14228; own dating clause LF14284–14286 reads: Datum Romae die vigesima quarta decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF14272 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
